identity.name: GymBro
identity.description: Sistema de gestão de academias moderno e de alta performance.
identity.tone: Performance Pro (Archetype 2) - High Energy, Precision, Strength.
identity.audience: Donos de academia no Brasil que valorizam tecnologia e design.

primary.description: Electric Lime - Use for CTAs, active states, and high-priority accents.

secondary.description: Zinc 800 - Use for secondary buttons and surface highlights.

accent.description: Electric Blue - Use for trust indicators, charts, and info states.

rules: NEVER use generic SaaS purple or teal.
Dark Mode is MANDATORY for the Admin Panel.
Landing Page should be Hybrid: Dark Hero -> Light/Grey Features -> Dark Footer.
Use 'Electric Lime' sparingly for 'Punch' (Buttons, KPIs). Don't overuse it.
Headings MUST be Uppercase and Condensed.
Body text should have generous line-height (leading-relaxed).

elements: H1: Impactful Slogan (e.g., 'TRANSFORME SEU CORPO, DOMINE SUA MENTE')
Background: Dark Gym Image with heavy gradient overlay (black to transparent).

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar Navigation + Topbar + Main Content Area

widgets.kpi_cards: col-span-1. Minimalist. Label + Big Number + Trend.
widgets.access_feed: col-span-1 row-span-2. Real-time list of entries (Avatar + Time + Status).

buttons.primary: bg-[#ccff00] text-black hover:bg-[#b3e600] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider h-12 px-8 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide h-12 px-6
buttons.outline: border-2 border-zinc-700 text-white hover:border-[#ccff00] hover:text-[#ccff00] bg-transparent uppercase font-semibold h-12 px-6

inputs.base: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-100 focus:ring-[#ccff00] focus:border-[#ccff00] h-12

libraries: framer-motion (for entrance animations and hover effects)

functionality_rules.forms: Use React Hook Form + Zod for validation (CPF validation is critical).
functionality_rules.tables: Use TanStack Table (optional) or simple mapping for lists. Must support pagination.
functionality_rules.turnstile: Visual indicator needed: Green Dot (Online), Red Dot (Offline). Log entries must show timestamp.

universal_guidelines: ALL TEXT MUST BE IN PORTUGUESE (PT-BR).
Do not use gradients on text unless it's a very large H1.
Ensure 3:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Form layouts: Group related fields (e.g., Personal Info vs Subscription) using CSS Grid (col-span-1 vs col-span-2).
